plan_approval_rule: Work-queue slots may only be generated while plan_status is approved and plan_approval_ref names an approved consent request of type plan_approval for the current plan. A material plan revision returns plan_status to proposed and needs a new approval.

phase_template.name: Example phase
phase_template.objective: Outcome boundary for a group of modules/work units.

work_unit_template.title: Small independently executable and verifiable slice

slot_mapping_rule: scripts/plan_to_slots.py maps each ready work unit of an approved plan to one queue slot: id SLOT-<work unit id>, work_unit_id/phase_id/module_id/requirement_ids/title/priority/risk_classification/eligibility/required_roles/required_capabilities/allowed_paths/denied_paths/acceptance_criteria/required_checks copied, objective -> description, dependencies stay work-unit IDs.
